fact: NITA-U's National Information Security Policy 2026, which says it defines mandatory policy requirements for ministries, departments, agencies and local governments, says cloud, interface, artificial intelligence and industrial control technologies must be deployed and managed in compliance with ISO/IEC 27001:2022, and that organisations must apply ISA/IEC 62443 to industrial control systems; the document gives no exact day, so NITA-U's 15 July 2026 launch date is used.
